_note: Corrected JSON-LD fragments for the findings in SCHEMA-REPORT.md. Each entry shows the current emitted output and the corrected output, plus where the change belongs in source. Findings 1 and 2 have been APPLIED as of 2026-08-15; the rest are still proposals.

finding-1-alumniOf-organization-type.problem: Every education entry is hardcoded to CollegeOrUniversity, so a secondary school is declared as a university.
implementation: Add to the Education type: organizationType: "CollegeOrUniversity" | "HighSchool";
Set organizationType on both entries in the education array.
Import HighSchool from schema-dts (verified present in the installed version).
alumniOf: education.map((entry): CollegeOrUniversity | HighSchool => ({ "@type": entry.organizationType, name: entry.institution, url: entry.url }))

finding-4-blogposting-publisher.problem: publisher is a Google-recommended Article property and is absent from all 20 BlogPosting nodes.
finding-4-blogposting-publisher.implementation: Add `publisher: personRef,` beside the existing `author: personRef,` in the postSchema graph.

finding-5-profilepage-datecreated.problem: Google recommends dateCreated alongside dateModified on ProfilePage.
finding-5-profilepage-datecreated.implementation: Added `export const siteCreated = "2024-09-07";` to src/seo/config.ts as a sibling of `lastUpdated` (a creation date is not a maintenance timestamp), exported it through the src/seo/index.ts barrel, and set `dateCreated: siteCreated` on the ProfilePage node. The date is the repository's initial commit 4c30d66, which is when the homepage first existed at this URL, so it is a real date rather than an invented one.

finding-6-logs-graph-consistency.problem: The Blog node has no isPartOf and does not link its own BreadcrumbList, unlike the other three fixed pages.

corrected_fragment.name: Field Logs by Sandev Abeykoon – Engineering Notes

finding-6-logs-graph-consistency.implementation: Add isPartOf: ref(siteId) and breadcrumb: ref(`${url}#breadcrumb`) to the Blog node. Note that #website is only defined on the homepage, so this becomes a cross-page reference, which Google resolves by URL.

finding-7-duplicate-linkedin-sameas.problem: sameAs lists a LinkedIn profile twice via its country mirror, asserting two identities where there is one, and hardcodes a profile URL outside personProfiles.
finding-7-duplicate-linkedin-sameas.implementation: Drop the hardcoded lk.linkedin.com entry so sameAs derives entirely from personProfiles and certifications.

finding-8-unattached-itemlist.problem: #featured-logs is a top-level graph node that nothing references. It yields no rich result in this vertical either way.
finding-8-unattached-itemlist.implementation: If it is meant as a relatedness signal, add `hasPart: ref(`${url}#featured-logs`)` to the ProfilePage node. Otherwise it is fine as-is.

finding-2-and-3-images.status: finding 2 APPLIED 2026-08-15 (200x200 resampled to 800x800 with sharp, lanczos3, 53.6 KB); finding 3 still open
finding-2-and-3-images.problem: public/sandev-abeykoon.jpg is 200x200 and 7.1 KB, well under the resolution Google's structured data image guidance expects. Separately, no post sets `image` in metadata.json, so all 20 BlogPosting nodes point at the shared public/og-image.jpg.
implementation: Re-export public/sandev-abeykoon.jpg at 1200x1200 (800x800 floor). No code change needed: personImage already resolves through imageUrl().

For per-post images, add an `image` field to the relevant metadata.json files pointing at a real file under public/. CLAUDE.md records that this must be a URL string, not a bundled asset import, because OG tags and JSON-LD need an actual URL.
finding-2-and-3-images.no_schema_fragment: Both are asset changes, not markup changes. The existing markup consumes them correctly.
